newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 18.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.

Tropical depression Ignacio was spotted at about 510 miles (816 km) west of Mexico's Baja California state coast in the Pacific. The ministry said the storm was expected to move north-northwest and lose intensity.
Ships were warned against sailing in the vicinity of Ignacio and in front of the Nayarit, Sinaloa and Jalisco state coastlines because of rains and strong winds.
In the Gulf of Mexico scattered rains were reported falling along Veracruz and Tabasco coasts.
Tropical winds in the Caribbean sent rains and strong winds along Central America.
